    • PROPERTY_PARAMETER_PREFIX

      public static final String PROPERTY_PARAMETER_PREFIX
      Name of property prefix to specify the index of the parameter on the ManagedFunction. The resulting parameter name and value are as: 
            PROPERTY_PARAMETER_PREFIX + "FunctionName" = "index in objects for the parameter (starting at 1)"
